primitives.name: Ball Carry Correction
primitives.verbatim_quote: AIR: venue air density 1.2641 kg/m3 measured at Soldier Field [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-18/weather-pilot/weather-stadium-pilot.json] -> ball carries measurably differently than a sea-level-standard model assumes ; wind 12.6 km/h qualifies it -> deep-ball and kick distances shift; totals and long-DK props carry the effect, spreads barely 2.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'air_density': '1.2641 kg/m³ (Soldier Field)', 'sea_level_density': '1.2250 kg/m³ (standard)', 'wind_speed': '12.6 km/h', 'drag_coefficient': 'dimensionless (typical value ~0.5)', 'ball_mass': '0.410 kg (NFL regulation)', 'ball_cross_sectional_area': '0.04 m²'}
primitives.assumptions: Incompressible Navier-Stokes flow, constant temperature, spherical projectile approximation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-altitude (Soldier Field elevation ~176 m) or extreme wind (>20 km/h) where linear drag models become insufficient.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Adjusts deep-ball probability distributions via drag scaling. GSE: Models trajectory sensitivity to air density via state-transition matrices.

primitives.name: Kalshi Market Anchor
primitives.verbatim_quote: MICROSTRUCTURE: Kalshi prints 0.46 on this game [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/kalshi/kalshi-nfl-digest.json] -> an independent Layer-1 anchor exists beside the de-vigged book line -> when the two agree within ~2 points, the prior is solid and L2 signals apply cleanly; divergence would flag a stale book 7.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'kalshi_price': '0.46 (dimensionless)', 'book_line': 'point spread (e.g., NE +3.5, CHI -3.5)', 'vig_adjustment': 'percentage vig applied to book', 'market_implied_probability': 'calculated from book line', 'confidence_threshold': 'typically 95% CI'}
primitives.assumptions: Efficient markets hypothesis, rational agent behavior, no liquidity constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Kalshi volume drops below 100 contracts, price stability degrades rapidly.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Uses Kalshi as a conformal prediction set for book line adjustments. GSE: Integrates market sentiment into belief state updates via particle filtering.
layer2.telemetry: Kalshi open interest vs. book maker delta, book line re-centering after Kalshi update
